title: The True Love Safe
prompt: Gideon's brass safe takes a 3-digit code. Engraved round the dial: "All the gifts my true love sent to me."
hint: Count every gift in every verse of The Twelve Days of Christmas. On the second day you get two turtle doves and another partridge.
explanation: 364. Each verse repeats the earlier gifts: 1, then 1+2, then 1+2+3, up to 1+2+...+12. Added together, that's 364 gifts.

title: The Ornament Box
prompt: The ornament box in the stockroom has a word lock. Find the word.
hint: Read the tree checklist. First things first.
explanation: ALMOND: the first letters of Angel, Lights, Mistletoe, Ornaments, Nativity, Doves. Agnes and Roz both signed the checklist.

title: The Till
prompt: The confectionery till opens with the time of a sale, as four 24-hour digits. When was the last gold marzipan truffle sold?
hint: When did the counter close tonight? Read the note on the till.
explanation: 1645. The counter closed at 5 PM, and Doris sold the last marzipan truffle a quarter of an hour before. The till roll shows that sale was on staff card 0012: Agnes.
